extraSettings.ntfyIntro: When someone calls you from Diddy while it is closed, the ntfy app shows “Name is calling you”. Calls from other apps do not send this.
extraSettings.httpsRequired: The server must start with https://.
extraSettings.ntfySetup: Install ntfy from the App Store, tap +, and subscribe to this topic on this server. Keep the topic to yourself: anyone who knows it can send you alerts.
extraSettings.topicPrivacy: The topic is stored in your direct messages, where the other person and their server can read it.
extraSettings.recoveryKeyHelp: The recovery key (or security key) or passphrase you saved when you set up encryption, for example in Diddy desktop or Element. It unlocks your message history on this device.
extraSettings.privateReadHelp: Others stop seeing that you type and how far you have read. Chats still count as read for you (a private read receipt, like on desktop).
extraSettings.returnNewlineHelp: Use the send button to send and Return for a new line.
extraSettings.animatedAvatarsHelp: GIF, WebP and APNG profile pictures move. In a call only while the person speaks.
extraSettings.animatedNameplatesHelp: Moving pictures, videos and gradients behind names in the member and DM lists.
extraSettings.profileEffectsHelp: Animated overlays other people put over their profile card.
extraSettings.profileDecorationsHelp: What other people add to their profile. Nameplates and effects that are off show a still picture, and with Reduce Motion turned on in iOS nothing moves.
extraSettings.customDateHelp: Custom format with the desktop's tokens, for example YYYY, MM, DD, D, MMM, MMMM, dddd. Text in [brackets] is shown as it is. Today: {{example}}
extraSettings.blockedHelp: Blocked people can't send you messages or invites. Unblock them to see their messages again.
extraSettings.aboutTech: Diddy for iOS is built with matrix-rust-sdk and LiveKit.
extraSettings.diagnosticsHelp: A text file with Diddy's log, crash reports and your device model, to attach to a bug report. It contains no messages or keys.
extraSettings.appIconHelp: Changes the icon on your home screen.
extraSettings.pageZoomHelp: Page Zoom goes from 75% to 150% and works on top of the text size set in iOS Settings.
extraSettings.customThemeHelp: Pick the “Custom” theme in the theme list to use these colors.
extraSettings.saveColorsHelp: Saving rebuilds the app screens with the new colors.
extraSettings.ringtoneHelp: Diddy can only ring while it is open. The ringtone follows the silent switch and also vibrates.
extraSettings.customSoundsHelp: Your own sounds stay on this device. Notifications while Diddy is in the background keep Diddy's sound.
extraSettings.noiseSuppressionHelp: Filters background noise such as fans and typing out of your microphone. Takes effect at once, also during a call.
extraSettings.voiceProcessingHelp: The system's echo cancellation and automatic gain. Keep it on if you use the speaker instead of headphones; off keeps music and other apps sounding normal. Applies the next time you join a call.
extraSettings.screenSharingHelp: For Whole Screen sharing. Higher values look sharper and move more smoothly, and use more battery and data; on a slow connection the call lowers them by itself. Sound of other apps goes out with your microphone and can also be switched while sharing. Applies the next time you start sharing.
extraSettings.badgeCountHelp: Counted in the grey badge. Applies on every device of your account.
extraSettings.allowNotificationsHelp: Allow notifications for Diddy in the Settings app, then turn this on again.
extraSettings.backgroundNotificationsHelp: Keeps Diddy running in the background so new messages, mentions and calls show up as notifications. Uses more battery. If iOS ends Diddy, for example after a restart, open it once to start again. Message, mention and invitation sounds are under Sounds.
extraSettings.ntfyClosedHelp: Get “Name is calling you” through the ntfy app while Diddy is closed.
extraSettings.emailSettingLoadFailed: The email setting could not be loaded.
extraSettings.keywordHelp: Set a notification preference for messages containing the given keyword. Swipe left on a keyword to remove it.
extraSettings.pushToTalkHelp: Your microphone is off until you hold Talk in the call. With a hardware keyboard (iPad), hold the keyboard key instead. Release Delay keeps it open a moment after you let go, so the end of a word is not cut off. Deafen wins: holding Talk does not undeafen you.
extraSettings.voiceActivityHelp: Voice activity: your microphone is open while it is on. Turn on Push to Talk to be heard only while you hold Talk.
extraSettings.alertSent: Sent. It should appear in ntfy within a few seconds.
extraSettings.imageUnreadable: This image could not be read.

calls.speaker: Speaker
calls.outputHelp: The volume of the whole device is set with the volume buttons. Output volume turns the call down further.
calls.personalVolumeHelp: Only you hear this change. Diddy remembers it for this person on this device.
calls.companionSoundHelp: The call sound keeps playing on your computer; this iPhone stays silent. You can turn the camera around in the call.
calls.moreBackToTheGridPinchOrDoubleTapToZoom: Back to the grid. Pinch or double tap to zoom.
calls.moreCloseItForYouOrStopItForEveryone: Close it for you or stop it for everyone
calls.moreHoldToTalkWithVoiceoverDoubleTapToSt: Hold to talk. With VoiceOver, double-tap to start and double-tap again to stop.
calls.moreEveryoneInTheCallSeesEverythingOnThi: Everyone in the call sees everything on this iPhone, including other apps, notifications and Diddy's settings. Diddy hides your recovery key while you share, but other apps do not.
calls.moreHiddenWhileYouShareYourScreenStopSha: Hidden while you share your screen. Stop sharing to enter or show your recovery key.
calls.moreWholeScreenKeepsSharingWhileYouUseOt: Whole screen keeps sharing while you use other apps
calls.moreReactionsSoundboardWatchTogetherDeaf: Reactions, soundboard, watch together, deafen and audio devices
calls.moreJoinItsCallAsItsCameraAndMicrophone: Join its call as its camera and microphone.
calls.moreThisIphoneStaysSilentTheCallPlaysOnY: This iPhone stays silent; the call plays on your computer.
calls.moreYourComputerSMicrophoneAndCameraGoOf: Your computer's microphone and camera go off meanwhile.
calls.moreYourComputerSButtonsControlThisIphon: Your computer's buttons control this iPhone too.
calls.moreKeepDiddyOpenIosPausesTheCameraInOth: Keep Diddy open: iOS pauses the camera in other apps. The microphone keeps going.
calls.moreYouCanUseOtherAppsMeanwhileTheMicrop: You can use other apps meanwhile; the microphone keeps going.

remainingUI.turnedOnPluginsAppearInThePuzzleButtonNe: Turned-on plugins appear in the puzzle button next to Settings. A plugin is a small web page that runs in a locked-down frame: no access to your account, messages or files. Only add plugins you trust.

remainingUI.diddyNeedsAHiddenRoomToShareProfilesBadg: Diddy needs a hidden room to share profiles, badges and name styles. Without it your customization cannot be saved or seen by others. Not an admin? Ask the admin of your server to set it up; Diddy joins it automatically.
